The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/engoebus/copyright.htm):
> The Holy Bible, Open English Bible translation, U. S. spelling edition
> Public Domain
> Language: English
> Translation by: OpenEnglishBible.org
> Please see OpenEnglishBible.org/ for information about this translation.
> 2026-10-13

What was found: Text: the Open English Bible, release 2025.6, by Russell Allen and contributors (living), dedicated by the project: "The OEB is under a Creative Commons Zero licence - that is, it is in the public domain." Its bases are the Twentieth Century New Testament (1904, anonymous), John Edgar McFadyen's Psalms (1916; he died 1933), Charles Foster Kent (1910-1922, US), the Jewish Publication Society 1917 (US) and, for Joshua only, James Moffatt (1870-1944). The preface says the Old Testament leans on "the work of James Moffatt, John Edgar McFadyen and Charles Foster Kent" without naming an edition. In this archive only Joshua is Moffatt's: its source file names no other base, and its editing notes replace Moffatt's own words ("Eternal > Lord", "compact > covenant", "yards > cubits"; https://github.com/openenglishbible/Open-English-Bible/blob/master/source/06-Joshua.usfm.db). A comparison of all of Joshua with Moffatt's first edition (The Old Testament, a New Translation, vol. I, New York, George H. Doran Company, "COPYRIGHT, 1924 ... PRINTED IN THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA", https://archive.org/details/oldtestament0001jame) and with the revised and final edition (Harper, "COPYRIGHT, 1922, 1924, 1925, 1926, 1935", 1950 printing, https://archive.org/details/newtranslationof0000jame) shows that OEB follows the 1924 wording wherever the two editions differ. Examples: 2:16 "make your way back" (1935: "make your retreat"), 3:13 "Whenever the soles" (1935: "As soon as the soles"), 6:21 "they massacred all in the city" (1935: "massacring all inside"). The single exception is the added word "of" in 11:21, "Israel and of Judah". The Moffatt layer is therefore the 1924 US first publication, public domain in the United States, and Moffatt died in 1944 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/James_Moffatt), so it is also public domain in every country with a term of life + 70 years or shorter.

The verse-per-line archive holds the Bible text in one file, one verse per line, each line starting with its reference (book, chapter:verse); its SQL and XML copies of the same text, eBible.org's description page, style sheet and signature are left out of the source.

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=engoebus), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/engoebus/copyright.htm), https://openenglishbible.org/; https://openenglishbible.org/faq/; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openenglishbible/Open-English-Bible/master/legal/CONTRIBUTORS.md.

note: The verse-numbered twin of ebible-engoebus-f522205a, for the parallel verses measure only (#35): its tag is verse-numbers alone, which no mixture selects, so it never enters training. eBible.org rebuilds this zip often; the checksum covers the files inside.
